content: We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template (ID 1914386) to the molecule given (initial_molecule). The previous step gave mapped_rxn and template_id. We need to apply the template to the molecule to get precursors. Use apply_template tool with molecule SMILES and template_id. Template ID is numeric? The tool expects string like "template_123". But maybe we can pass the numeric ID? The get_template expects "template_123". However apply_template expects template_id string. We have template_id 1914386. Likely the ID format is just that number as string. Let's try apply_template with molecule SMILES and template_id "1914386".
